image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white hamster sitting inside a bright green plastic bowl or container. The hamster is facing forward, with its front paws resting on the rim. The lighting is somewhat dim, casting shadows inside the bowl. A blue object (possibly a shoe or toy) is visible in the bottom right corner outside the bowl.

Two distinct, small, black bead-like eyes are clearly visible and symmetrically placed.
Both ears are visible, appearing rounded and proportionate to the head size, consistent with hamster anatomy.
